info.name: Dark Store - All Services CRUD and E2E
info.description: Run sequentially with Postman Collection Runner after starting PostgreSQL, Auth (8081), Inventory (8082), Order (8083), and Gateway (8080). Set adminPassword and inventoryInternalToken in the selected environment. Public API requests use the Gateway; an internal-token check calls Inventory directly. Covers supported Auth, user, address, store, catalog, inventory, cart, order, and payment operations plus checkout, reservation, cancellation, fulfillment, and Order-to-Inventory synchronization. Delete operations are included only where the API exposes them.

exec: pm.test("Has tokens and ADMIN role", function () { pm.expect(j.accessToken).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(j.refreshToken).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(j.user.role).to.eql("ADMIN"); pm.expect(j.expiresIn).to.eql(900); });
pm.test("Got a new refresh token", function () { pm.expect(j.refreshToken).to.not.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("oldCustomerRefresh")); });

exec: pm.test('product with stock history is protected', () => pm.response.to.have.status(409));
pm.test('adjusted product is low', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().some(item => item.productId === pm.collectionVariables.get('productId'))).to.eql(true));
pm.test('available quantity and price returned', () => { const item = pm.response.json().items[0]; pm.expect(item.available).to.eql(2); pm.expect(Number(item.price)).to.eql(4.5); });
pm.test('internal reservation for confirm created', () => pm.response.to.have.status(201));
